title: Create a light version without bundled dependencies
body:
We could do this:

* expose instantsearch.react/lodash/hogan => allow people building widgets reusing our dependencies
* declare react/lodash/hogan/algoliasearch/algoliasearch-helper as externals in a new build named instantsearch.without.deps\[.min].js
  * this would mean that the user would have to include react/lodash/hogan/algoliasearch/.. in his own webpage
